# BAD-027 — Handle search and a suspended filter on the admin /accounts list

## Brief
Once my.badtakes.io/@handle is public, a report will name a handle, not an email. The dashboard's /accounts search matches account_email only (admin/src/lib/accounts.ts:715) and its status filter is licence status (active/revoked, :717, :632), so an operator cannot find the account behind @handle or list suspended profiles; the 2026-08-20 design's /profiles list (search by handle, active/suspended filter) was folded into /accounts without those two controls. Not blocking phase 4: every moderation control is reachable from the account page by email and the audit log lists profile.suspend rows.

Evidence: admin/src/lib/accounts.ts:715 'a.account_email like ...'; :717 status = licence status; admin/src/components/AccountFilters.tsx has no suspended option; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-20-user-profiles-and-handles-design.md § New screens and controls

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, no children: two query predicates shared between the page and its count fallback, one facet count, one select option and a placeholder in a client component, a suspended badge on the list's handle cell, and a text-assertion test under test/server/. Opus is the engineer tier; nothing here is a data-model or security decision.
